newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas active, market recoups losses.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas active, market recoups losses.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were firmer on Thursday in active trade which saw a healthy 540 lots change hands.
September again led the market, but this time higher after the contract's break below nine pence a therm pushed the market down on Wednesday.
With 190 lots traded, September gained 0.10 pence a therm to end at 8.90 pence a therm, although the month fetched nine pence on the over-the-counter market.
A further 100 lots were traded on October, which gained 0.090 pence to 10.740 pence.
Further out most months made gains, although June shed 0.250 pence to end the day at 10.40 pence.
The balance of month contract, which was introduced last Friday, has attracted little interest and was untraded again on Thursday.
